cost_model: One synthetic expert review = one assumed review unit. Not measured minutes, euros, or human effort. Policy CPU latency is measured locally and does not include network/LLM time.
limitations: Synthetic scenario distribution; not plant data or a user study.
False reuse means violating the declared applicability/evidence contract, NOT all incorrect physical actions. Execution failures are reported separately.
The full gate encodes these known contract checks, so zero contract violations on this fixture is a conformance result by construction, not empirical proof of superiority on unknown industrial data.
accepted_only is an accepted-record retrieval baseline, not a measured production RAG or LLM system.
semantic_rules and durability_gate share a simple semantic rule. Added checks must justify their integration cost.
An accepted but wrongly authored fix can pass the reuse gate and still fail independent execution. That negative control is deliberately retained.
No evidence that an agent council improves these deterministic checks.
implementation: Policy and oracle code are separate, but both implement this same authored fixture specification; they are not an external industrial oracle.
